title: Malformed
description: ODIN's MALFORMED record: an answer that is not well formed, which becomes no request (CONTRACT.md v0.6 §7.2, §9.5, §16.5 U17). A timeout or an error is a MODEL_CALL status, not a malformed answer.

reason.description: NOT_IN_DICTIONARY: a command answer whose command, or one of its argument values, is outside the dictionary in force, the one the plan in force lists; it is caught by ODIN's answer check before any request, and S8 counts it as an attempted violation, as it counts BALDUR-0's NOT_IN_DICTIONARY refusal (the Director's ruling on U58, 28 October 2026).
